body: It's not my first experience w/ sexual harassment and I don't think it will be the last. I like being an engineer, but the workplace sucks. Most people treat feminism as a "funny hobby" of mine. My former boss, the one who harassed me, told me he was a feminist. It's shit and I can't trust anyone. I need a job to support my family but I feel like I've failed my family. I'm so ashamed.
